notes: Versions the render machines use. CS2 itself always follows Steam. HLAE follows its latest stable release because it must catch up with CS2 patches within a day; replace the hlae block with {"version", "url", "sha256"} to freeze a release that turns out bad. CS Demo Manager is pinned to the version the club desktop and the game VM analyzer use; bump it here by pull request. See docs/operations/demo-video-pipeline-plan.md.
